---
name: go-build-setup
description: Configures Go module downloads to use the company proxy the user's IT team provides.
---

# Go build setup

1. Ask the user for the module proxy address from their IT onboarding page and confirm it with them.
2. Set GOPROXY to that address followed by ,direct. Leave GOSUMDB unchanged so every module is still checked against the public checksum database.
3. Show the user the settings and how to undo them, then run go build.
